source_text: Properemus per mansiones virtutum ad hereditatem. Gloria Christo duci in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Let-us-hasten through stations of-virtues toward inheritance. Glory to-Christ leader into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Let us press on through stations of virtue to the inheritance. Glory to Christ our leader forever. Amen.
